name: Legend of the Ematahn
summary:
# Embark on a new adventure!

As you're beginning to make friends with a nearby village, a new group emerges that threatens the stability of the Highlands. Legend of the Ematahn is an action adventure game featuring physics based combat, magic, an original story, and a world waiting to be explored. Complete quests for the different factions of the Highlands. Uncover a history of conflict and defend the people against threats of all kind. Are you up to the challenge?
